ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached circuit diagram shows an operational amplifier. The upper input is marked as the inverting input “−”; it is connected to a +1 V source through a 10 kΩ resistor, and it is also connected to the output node U0 through a 100 kΩ feedback resistor. The lower input is marked as the non-inverting input “+”; it is connected to a +2 V source through a 9.1 kΩ resistor. The output node on the right is labeled U0. Reasoning: Treat the op amp as ideal and operating with negative feedback through the 100 kΩ resistor. Since the ideal op amp input draws no current, no current flows through the 9.1 kΩ resistor, so there is no voltage drop across it. Therefore the non-inverting input voltage is 2 V. With negative feedback, the inverting input is also at 2 V. Apply KCL at the inverting input node. Let that node voltage be 2 V. The current through the 10 kΩ resistor is (2 V − 1 V) / 10 kΩ. The current through the 100 kΩ feedback resistor is (2 V − U0) / 100 kΩ. Since no current enters the op amp input: (2 − 1)/10k + (2 − U0)/100k = 0. Multiplying by 100k gives 10 + 2 − U0 = 0, so U0 = 12 V.

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个运算放大器电路，输出端标为 U0。输出端通过 100 kΩ 电阻反馈到反相输入端；+1 V 信号通过 10 kΩ 电阻接到反相输入端；+2 V 信号通过 9.1 kΩ 电阻接到同相输入端。推理：按理想运放处理，输入电流为零，因此 9.1 kΩ 电阻上无压降，同相端电压为 Vref = 2 V。负反馈使反相端电压也等于 2 V。对反相端节点列 KCL：(2 - 1)/10 kΩ + (2 - U0)/100 kΩ = 0。等价于有偏置的反相放大器公式 U0 = Vref(1 + Rf/Rin) - (Rf/Rin)Vin，其中 Rin = 10 kΩ，Rf = 100 kΩ，Vin = 1 V，Vref = 2 V。代入得 U0 = 2 × (1 + 10) - 10 × 1 = 22 - 10 = 12 V。
